portals.name: Back up: The Field Station Cache

interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The factor's signature
interactives.text: The Barrens factor signs for a shard once. What is made under the observatory is checked against the eleven measures and counts double.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The tower's under-room; the wardens taught here before the observatory. Books read three times as fast.

interactives.label: Tuning
interactives.text: A shard is tuned by walking it past all eleven measures. Eleven collars, eleven lengths, no shortcuts.

interactives.label: The massif
interactives.text: The massif hums on the day before a storm. Count the hum and you know the hour.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The eleven measures
interactives.text: The measures were cut from one crystal. The twelfth length was never set; the factor knows why.

interactives.label: The storm ruins
interactives.text: The ruins were not storm-broken. They were struck, once each, on the same night.

interactives.label: The vault
interactives.text: The Resonant Vault under the observatory was a mine before it was a vault.

interactives.label: The Massif Reliquary
interactives.text: Sealed with a resonant crystal; the massif's own relic room.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Harvest
interactives.text: A pickaxe in the pack or in the hand is the same to a seam. A seam above your level takes ten times as long, not twice.

sections.name: The Geode Hollow
sections.label: A seam of crystal that hums at a touch; the rock behind it is thin.
sections.note: A geode the prospectors never finished: crystal on every wall and a pool of dust.

sections.name: The Shard Garden
sections.label: A seam of crystal that hums at a touch; the rock behind it is thin.
sections.note: Shards grown in beds under a lid of storm rock, faster than the open field.

sections.name: The Field Station Cache
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: The station's cellar: a chest, a bench and the shards the wardens sort in private.

sections.name: The Observatory Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The wardens' strongroom under the observatory.

sections.name: The Beetle Pit
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: A storm-ruin cellar the wardens stock with beetles for the young to break their shields on.

sections.name: The Tower School
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Where the wardens learn to read a resonance chart.

sections.name: The Resonance Spring
sections.label: A seam of crystal that hums at a touch; the rock behind it is thin.
sections.note: Under the ring the water hums, and wounds close to the hum.

sections.name: The Bridge Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A gallery under the crystal bridge; scorpions at the far end for slow shots.

sections.name: The Massif Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: Sealed with a resonant crystal; the massif's own relic room.

sections.name: The Storm Well
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Storm rock swallows spells. The spiders penned here never learnt that.

sections.name: The Shard Focus
sections.label: A seam of crystal that hums at a touch; the rock behind it is thin.
sections.note: Where the shards hang the ether pools; spells cost half.

sections.name: The Sap
sections.label: A sink in the sand that never fills.
sections.note: A sap the wardens drove south under the dust, out onto the steppe.

sections.name: The Barrens Waystone
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Four stones under the field station. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Geode Eyrie
sections.label: A seam of crystal that hums at a touch; the rock behind it is thin.
sections.note: A crystal pocket over the cave mouth.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Amethyst Barrens Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
